svg.title: Art-Net diagnostics, errors and performance tuning
svg.desc: Follow packet, complete-frame, submit and DMA counters in order. Validate universe coverage, length and sequence before adjusting buffering. Distinguish intentional replacement from receive loss. Measure pacing, ring pressure and timing; use non-black patterns and physical checks.

g.text: Find the first stage that stops progressing.
Compare counter deltas over the same interval. Change one variable, repeat, and verify recovery.
100 µs was not a universal fix.
